project_type: Next.js 16 + Clean Architecture + DDD + Prisma ORM + TypeScript strict mode
build_system: npm + Next.js build, Prisma generate for client
verification_instructions: Run npx tsc --noEmit to verify TypeScript compilation passes without errors. This is the primary verification for this task as it's focused on fixing broken connections/types.
snapshot_or_generated_files: src/generated/prisma/ contains Prisma client generated files (created via npx prisma generate). Do not modify these directly.
environment_constraints: Use path aliases (@core/*, @infrastructure/*, etc.) as defined in tsconfig.json. Never use long relative paths (../../..). All repositories must return DomainResult<T> pattern.
contribution_requirements: Follow Clean Architecture: core has no external dependencies, infrastructure implements core interfaces, DI via Awilix factory functions. All repositories must be stateless singletons. Error handling uses AppError types with stable error codes.
key_patterns: Repository implementations use factory function pattern: export const XxxRepositoryImpl = ({ prismaClient }: { prismaClient: PrismaClient }): IXxxRepository => { ... }. Map Prisma models to domain entities via mapper functions. Return DomainResult<T> using ok() and fail() helpers from @core/utils.
directory_structure: src/core/ - domain layer (entities, interfaces, types), src/infrastructure/ - implementation layer (repositories, DI, adapters), src/presentation/ - UI layer (features, components, viewModels), src/app/ - Next.js App Router pages, prisma/ - schema and migrations
